cases.name: live_globals_and_builtins
cases.source:
name = 'module'
def read(): return name
print(read())
name = 'later'
print(read())
del name
try: read()
except NameError as error: print(type(error).__name__)
def size(): return len([1, 2])
print(size())
len = lambda value: 77
print(size())
del len
print(size())

cases.name: transitive_capture
type_parameters
cases.source:
T = 'module'
def read[T](): return T.__name__
def outer[T]():
    def inner(): return T.__name__
    return inner
print(read(), outer()())

cases.name: comprehension_capture
cases.source:
token = 'module'
def make(): return [lambda: token for token in [1, 2]]
readers = make()
print([read() for read in readers])
print(token)

cases.name: class_barrier
cases.source:
value = 'module'
def outer():
    value = 'outer'
    class C:
        value = 'class'
        def read(self): return value
    return C
print(outer()().read())
